properties.description: Layer 1d of the cross-design view, on top of cap:compare-and-compose-take-the-other-design-by-graph-id. READS widened: certify_preservation (other_graph_id; base_path optional; the live graph is the base, as compare_designs), merge_designs (other_graph_id = theirs and base_graph_id = the common ancestor; ours is the live graph; the three paths optional — a proposal, it writes nothing), analyze_alternatives (other_graph_ids, a list; the live graph the baseline; paths optional, {"paths": []} answers as before), pair_designs and seam_report (other_graph_id or the inline design, exactly one). All resolve through ReflowService::other_design: the other design exported first and its guard dropped, then the live graph read — no call holds two guards; a merge reads the ancestor, then theirs, then the live graph. A graph_id with a path or inline export is refused naming both; other_design_named makes a refusal name the argument used. REGISTRY REFUSALS through one function, refuse_a_path_on_a_registry: every READ above, plus fork_point (export_path), describe_designs (paths — it WAS handing any caller the graph_id and label of a design stored at a host path), apply_merge (base_path, theirs_path), import_graph (path; an inline document still imports — it WAS importing a host file's requirement into the design), external_dependency (a non-blank design_export; "" still stops a watch). stdio and --shared unchanged. STILL OPEN on a registry, read in the code and not measured (named in AGENTS.md): export_graph and export_surface write to a given path; wall_check reads the checkout at root; a stored design_export is read by upstream_status and loop_status; loop_status since_export reads the sync sidecar. Built 2026-10-11 (13d2c8c27): failing first, 4 of 4 new tests failed (the registry-path test found 9 path calls answered from host files and import_graph importing one); after, 4 of 4 and #720's 6 of 6; toolsnaps for the five widened tools re-blessed (197 match); workspace 382 binaries, 2,994 passed, 0 failed.
